SBP: Informs family member of the next step (e.g., seeing the patient, waiting in family room, etc.)
Offers support services (e.g., social worker, chaplain, calling additional family, etc.)
ICS: Confirms family member’s relationship to the patient
Inquires what the family member already knows
Gives a warning – (e.g., “I have some bad news for you….”)
Gives important news without unnecessary delay
Deliver the news that the patient’s son died in the cath lab
Uses appropriate compassionate communication and body language
Inquires if the family member has any questions
